description: Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst will support Operation Services, an internal department that aids construction projects. The role involves completing engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for various main and service works, collecting construction activity 'as-built' data with mobile CPS devices in the field, creating permanent asset records, and editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. The analyst will also perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before posting, represent Engineering at project meetings, and conduct field visits to job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Responsibilities Complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for all types of main and service work. Collect construction activity 'as-built' using mobile CPS devices in the field for creating permanent asset records. Edit map features and correlating attribute data in the GIS. Perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before it is posted to the GIS. Represent Engineering at internal and external project meetings as required. Visit job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Perform preliminary reviews of development plans and interface with customers. Implement and train Engineering staff on new work processes for the GIS mapping system. Distribute and update maps for other departments as requested. Approve requests for the acquisition and release of easements and vacation of rights-of-way. Perform pipeline safety compliance-related GIS analysis as directed. Execute all other duties as assigned. Essential Skills Proficiency in ArcGIS and CAD. Knowledge of geography and construction drawings. Experience with as-built drawings, cost forecasting, and drafting. Additional Skills & Qualifications Ability to complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS. Experience in collecting construction activity 'as-built' data using mobile CPS devices. Skill in editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. Work Environment The role is based in a professional engineering office, initially requiring attendance five days per week, reducing to three days per week after training. Work may be performed in both office and field settings, with exposure to the elements. Typical hours are 7:00 a.m. to 3:45 p.m., Monday through Friday, with potential for overtime and travel. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $25.00 - $27.00/hr. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. If eligible, the benefits available for this temporary role may include the following: • Medical, dental & vision • Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions available • Life Insurance (Voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependent

Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst supports GIS data management, analysis, and process improvement initiatives in a utility-focused environment. In this role, you analyze spatial and tabular data, perform data conversions and migrations, maintain and enhance GIS databases, and develop solutions for data integrations and transformations. You conduct advanced GIS analysis, QA/QC, application testing, reporting, map creation, and automation using tools such as ArcGIS Pro, Model Builder, and Python. You work closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs, improve workflows, and support ongoing GIS initiatives that are critical to utility infrastructure. Responsibilities Edit, update, and maintain GIS datasets to ensure accuracy and consistency across the utility GIS environment. Perform GIS data analysis and data mining to support operational decision-making and project planning. Process and convert spatial and tabular data from various sources into GIS formats suitable for analysis and mapping. Conduct QA/QC checks on GIS data prior to production use to ensure data integrity and reliability. Support database maintenance activities, including data loading, updates, and structure optimization for GIS applications. Create specialized queries, maps, and reports tailored to stakeholder requirements and project objectives. Analyze existing GIS-related processes and workflows, and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and data quality. Support application testing and documentation for GIS tools, integrations, and workflows. Work independently on multiple GIS assignments, managing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and other GIS professionals, to support utility GIS initiatives. Apply linear referencing techniques to locate and manage pipeline and utility assets based on stationing and distance measures along linear features. Utilize Python scripting and/or Model Builder to automate routine GIS tasks and streamline data processing. Contribute to modernization efforts and process improvements by leveraging advanced Esri technologies and best practices in geospatial data management. Essential Skills Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting GIS work, ideally within utility, pipeline, telecommunications, municipal, or similar environments. Advanced proficiency with ArcGIS Pro, including editing, analysis, and map production capabilities. Hands-on experience with linear referencing systems (LRS), including practical application for locating assets along linear features. Strong skills in GIS data analysis, QA/QC, and database maintenance within an enterprise GIS context. Experience with Python scripting and/or Model Builder to automate GIS workflows and data processing tasks. Bachelors Degree in Geography/GIS, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Ability t

Cognizant is a large IT Consulting Firm that leverages modern technologies to transform a variety of business operations. We are seeking a data-driven Business Analyst to design and optimize customer support, teleoperations, and remote assistance workflows for our autonomous taxi (robotaxi) fleet. In this role, you will act as the bridge between autonomous vehicle operations and rider support. While you will not be performing raw point-cloud or sensor signal processing, you must bring a solid conceptual understanding of the autonomous stack—including ADAS, LiDAR, radar, and camera perception—to accurately translate vehicle events into real-time agent workflows. You will pair this domain literacy with strong SQL, Python, and modern dashboarding skills, alongside hands-on application of GenAI and GenBI, to automate customer interactions and drive fleet performance insights. Please note that this role is fully onsite in Plano, TX . Role Responsibilities Autonomous Fleet & Teleoperations Workflows: Define functional requirements for contact center agents and remote-guidance operators handling robotaxi edge cases (e.g., sensor-degradation alerts, pick-up/drop-off deadlocks, unexpected stops). Translate vehicle health, perception status flags (LiDAR/radar/camera health indicators), and ADAS state transitions into clear operational triggers for the support team. Define and track mission-critical metrics: Time-to-Intervene (TTI), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Rider Safety NPS. Data Analytics, SQL & Dashboard Engineering: Write complex SQL queries across relational databases and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) to track intervention trends, fleet exceptions, and call center throughput. Use Python (Pandas, NumPy) for exploratory data analysis, pattern identification in incident data, and automated reporting scripts. Design, build, and maintain production-grade operational dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight to deliver real-time operational visibility to executive and operations teams. GenAI & GenBI Implementation: Specify functional requirements for contact center GenAI tools: real-time call summarization, automated agent response recommendations, and context-aware action triggers. Support the rollout of GenBI tools (e.g., Power BI Copilot, ThoughtSpot, Amazon Q) to enable operations stakeholders to query fleet and support data using natural language. Collaborate with AI engineers to design safety guardrails, prompt templates, and evaluation criteria for customer-facing conversational agents inside the vehicle. Agile Delivery & Product Backlog: Author detailed PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams (BPMN) in Jira and Confluence. Partner with Teleoperations Leads, Fleet Operations, Data Engineers, and CCaaS engineering teams to deliver iterative platform upgrades. Desired Skills & Experience Domain Knowledge : We would prefer someone with 3+ years in the Aut

Job Summary Serve as a business analyst specializing in payment products and automatic payment workflows translating complex business needs into clear functional solutions that optimize hybrid day shift operations while collaborating across global teams. Apply deep Spanish language fluency to support stakeholders refine payment processes and enhance secure transaction experiences for customers and society. Responsibilities Analyze current automatic payment processes and payment product functionalities to identify gaps inefficiencies and opportunities for continuous improvement that enhance operational reliability and customer trust in transactions. Document detailed business requirements for payment product features by engaging with stakeholders across business and technology teams and ensuring that specifications are precise and aligned with regulatory and compliance expectations. Collaborate with product owners and technical teams to validate functional payment solutions and ensure that designed workflows for automatic payments are efficient scalable and user centric for a diverse customer base. Translate complex payment product concepts and rules into clear user stories acceptance criteria and process maps that guide development activities and support transparent communication among multilingual stakeholders. Perform detailed impact analysis for proposed changes to automatic payment systems and payment product configurations to minimize risk and safeguard the stability of transaction processing environments. Coordinate and execute functional testing for payment products including regression and integration testing to verify that automatic payment features operate correctly across upstream and downstream systems. Develop and maintain documentation for payment product functionalities including process flows configuration details and reference guides that support cross functional teams in hybrid work settings. Engage with operations and support teams to analyze incident trends in payment processing and propose targeted enhancements that reduce failure rates and improve customer experience outcomes. Use Spanish native language skills to facilitate workshops requirement gathering sessions and status communications with Spanish speaking stakeholders thereby improving clarity and alignment on payment product initiatives. Monitor key performance indicators related to automatic payment success rates processing times and exception volumes and produce analytical reports that inform data driven decisions for product refinement. Support risk and compliance reviews by explaining business logic behind payment product functionalities and documenting controls that contribute to secure and ethically responsible financial transactions. Collaborate in a hybrid work model by effectively managing virtual and onsite interactions and maintaining consistent communication practices that keep cross regional teams informed on project progress. Job Summary We are seeking a Senior Azure AI Engineer (.NET & OpenAI) to design, develop, and implement innovative AI-powered solutions for a large-scale enterprise environment. This role combines expertise in Azure AI services, OpenAI technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), and .NET development to transform unstructured business data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building AI-driven applications, optimizing model performance, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-impact solutions. *Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future* About the Role As a Senior Azure AI Engineer (.NET & OpenAI) , you will play a key role in developing and scaling enterprise AI solutions leveraging Azure AI services, OpenAI technologies, and .NET applications . You will work with large document repositories, applying AI and LLM capabilities to extract meaningful insights, automate processes, and improve business outcomes. In this client-facing role, you will contribute to solution architecture, provide technical recommendations, and collaborate closely with business and technical teams to deliver AI initiatives from concept through implementation. Success in this role requires a strong blend of hands-on engineering expertise, problem-solving skills, and the ability to guide stakeholders on AI best practices and scalable solution design. In This Role, You Will · Train and optimize AI models using large document repositories (4,000+ files). · Identify patterns, perform intelligent data extraction, and transform content into structured digital insights. · Support AI solution design, implementation, and scaling activities. · Provide recommendations on architecture, approach, and best practices. · Work closely with the client team in a hands-on capacity. Work Model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. *Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future* Required Qualifications · Strong hands-on experience with Azure AI technologies and .Net · Solid understanding of LLM concepts, including OpenAI GPT 4.1 / GPT 5.1 ecosystems · Experience in AI model training, prompt engineering, and solution implementation · Ability to provide technical guidance and consultative recommendations to client stakeholders · Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities Salary and Other Compensation: Applications will be accepted until December 6 th , 2026. The annual salary for this position is between $70,000 - $117,000 depending on the experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Job summary Sr Business Analyst role focused on analyzing complex business processes translating stakeholder needs into clear requirements and driving impactful solutions that align with organizational strategy. The role involves hybrid work with day shifts collaborating across teams to improve performance optimize operations and enable data informed decisions while ensuring consistent delivery quality and sustainable value. Responsibilities Analyze diverse business processes and stakeholder objectives to identify improvement opportunities that enhance operational efficiency and support strategic organizational goals. Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather detailed business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation. Document current and future state workflows with precise process maps and narratives that help stakeholders understand impacts dependencies and required changes. Evaluate potential solution options using structured analysis techniques and recommend approaches that balance business value feasibility and long term sustainability. Facilitate requirement walkthroughs and feedback sessions with stakeholders to confirm shared understanding resolve ambiguities and secure alignment on scope and priorities. Support development and configuration activities by clarifying requirements answering business context questions and validating proposed technical designs against business needs. Design comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance criteria that verify end to end coverage of requirements and enable robust user acceptance testing outcomes. Analyze data and performance metrics from implemented solutions to measure value realization identify gaps or issues and propose improvements that refine business outcomes. Prepare clear status reports and analytic summaries that communicate progress risks and insights to stakeholders in a concise and actionable format. Coordinate hybrid working interactions by planning onsite and remote collaboration sessions that maintain productivity inclusiveness and timely decision making. Ensure compliance with internal standards and industry regulations in all analysis deliverables so that solutions are secure ethical and aligned to societal expectations. Contribute to knowledge sharing by creating reusable templates guidelines and best practice documentation that strengthen the business analysis capability across the company. Partner with business and technology teams to ensure that implemented solutions improve customer and employee experiences and positively impact broader communities. Qualifications Apply deep business analysis expertise gained from eight to ten years of experience to interpret complex stakeholder needs and convert them into structured requirements. Demonstrate strong proficiency in business analysis practices and business analysis and planning disciplines such as process modeling requirements elicitation and impac

About Cognizant Workday Cognizant Workday practice is recruiting for upcoming graduates who are looking for an exciting, entry level consulting opportunity starting in the summer of 2027. We proudly partner with Workday, one of the leading cloud-based software solutions for HR, finance and payroll management. About the role As a Workday Data Conversion Analyst, you will make an impact by helping customers get the most out of their Workday implementations as part of a dynamic transformation consulting project team. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Workday practice team and work collaboratively with lead consultants, project managers, Engagement Managers, experienced Workday implementation professionals, and clients. In this role, you will Complete training and earn a Workday certification Participate in Workday implementation activities related to data conversion, including discovery, design, configuration, documentation, testing, and project review sessions. Learn to use Workday data conversion tools such as iLoad, EIBs, Object Transporter, and Advanced Load to perform tenant-to-tenant migrations. Learn the basics of the Workday product to effectively validate data, troubleshoot issues, and support your project team. Frequently update your project lead, manager, and Engagement Manager on timelines, tasks, risks, responsibilities, tenant management, and data conversion. Stay current on Workday updates and project changes, and proactively seek opportunities to grow your skills. Work model At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Plano, TX. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you must have to be considered Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, MIS, or a related field. Strong Excel competency, including formulas, pivot tables, and ASAP Utilities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively manage customer expectations. Ability to work well individually and in a team environment, with willingness to travel to customer sites when needed. These will help you succeed Knowledge of Workday. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

About the Role: As an AWS Databricks Data Engineer , you will make an impact by designing, developing, and supporting scalable data platforms, modern Lakehouse architectures, and AI-enabled data solutions on AWS. You will be a valued member of the Data Engineering team and work collaboratively with data architects, analytics teams, platform engineers, business stakeholders, and client teams to deliver high-quality data products and insights. In This Role, You Will: Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using PySpark, Databricks, and AWS cloud services. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. Strong proficiency in PySpark, Spark SQL, and distributed data processing frameworks. Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipelines and Lakehouse architectures. Hands-on experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data governance, lineage tracking, and role-based access control (RBAC). Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB), and release management processes. description: About the role As a Data Strategy & Data Governance Consultant , you will make an impact by driving enterprise data initiatives that improve data quality, governance, analytics enablement, and business decision-making. You will be a valued member of the Data Strategy team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, dealers, technology teams, data architects, and governance organizations to maximize the value of enterprise and dealer data assets. This role combines data strategy, data governance, business engagement, data modeling, and analytics enablement to ensure high-quality, trusted data is available to support critical business operations and strategic initiatives. In this role, you will: Partner with business stakeholders, dealers, and technical teams to identify, document, and prioritize data use cases that deliver measurable business value. Facilitate requirements gathering sessions and translate business needs into data strategies, governance standards, and analytical solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop analytics, integrations, and business applications leveraging enterprise data assets. Design and maintain logical and physical data models supporting enterprise data management and analytics initiatives. Develop and maintain data dictionaries, metadata repositories, data lineage documentation, interface specifications, and knowledge management assets. Define and implement enterprise data governance standards, policies, and change management processes. Establish and promote data quality frameworks, validation standards, stewardship processes, and monitoring practices. Develop SQL queries and perform source-to-target data validation to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of enterprise data. Conduct data quality assessments and maturity evaluations while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Partner with business and technical leadership to resolve data issues, align on data standards, and support enterprise data strategy initiatives. Prepare executive-level presentations and recommendations that communicate business value, data insights, and governance outcomes. Support a globally distributed stakeholder community, including occasional early morning or evening collaboration sessions. Work model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring time in a Cognizant or client office as determined by project and business needs. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. job_title: Data Quality Engineer - Remote in Canada
location: Halifax,NS-6940 Mumford Rd, Nova Scotia, Canada
description: Data Quality Engineer As a Data Quality Engineer specializing in Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity at Cognizant, you will design and execute automated data validation across extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes, data warehouses, and data migrations. You will work with development and data engineering teams to verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source and target systems. This is a full-time, remote role open only to candidates located in Canada. In this role, you will Review business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and ETL designs to identify test scenarios and prepare test plans and cases. Design and execute ETL, data warehouse, and data migration tests, including automated data validation scripts using Tosca Data Integrity. Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data integrity checks, using SQL queries to validate transformations and load processes. Log, track, and retest defects in partnership with development and data engineering teams. Collaborate with onshore and offshore teams to deliver testing activities and prepare test execution reports and knowledge-transfer documentation. Provide regular status updates, identify risks, and support production validation activities. What you need to have to be considered 6+ years of overall experience in software testing, ETL testing, and data validation, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity. Strong experience in ETL, data warehouse, and data migration testing, including validation across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Hands-on SQL query writing and database testing experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or DB2. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and data integrity testing. Ability to analyze business requirements, data models, mapping documents, and technical specifications and translate them into test plans and test cases. Experience with test execution and defect management using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments and an onshore-offshore delivery model, with effective cross-functional collaboration. Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with clear verbal and written communication. These will help you stand out Insurance domain experience. Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Snowflake. Knowledge of data lake and big data testing. Experience with Informatica, DataStage, SSIS, Talend, or other ETL tools. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed.

FACETS & NetworX Configuration Analyst Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Remote - United States Job ID: 00071022791 FACETS & NetworX Configuration Analyst About the role As a FACETS & NetworX Configuration Analyst , you will support healthcare benefits and pricing configuration activities within FACETS and NetworX. You will work collaboratively with business, configuration, and testing teams to translate benefit requirements into system configuration, validate claim outcomes, and help resolve benefit and pricing-related issues. In this role, you will: Support FACETS Benefits Configuration based on business and benefit requirements, including copays, coinsurance, deductibles, benefit limits, and in-network/out-of-network benefits. Assist with NetworX pricing configuration and related validation activities. Perform configuration testing and validate expected healthcare claim outcomes. Support SIT/UAT testing, defect analysis, and resolution related to benefits and pricing configuration. Partner with senior team members, business stakeholders, and testing teams to implement configuration changes and maintain accurate documentation. Work model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered 3 years of experience in healthcare, healthcare IT, claims processing, benefits configuration, or a related area. Basic understanding of or exposure to FACETS Benefits Configuration. Basic understanding of or exposure to NetworX pricing configuration. Working knowledge of healthcare claims processing and adjudication, including deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and benefit limits. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills, with an ability and willingness to learn FACETS and NetworX configuration. These will help you stand out Hands-on exposure to FACETS benefits configuration in a healthcare payer environment. Exposure to NetworX pricing and provider reimbursement configuration. Experience supporting SIT/UAT testing, claim validation, or defect resolution. Understanding of in-network and out-of-network benefit structures. Experience working collaboratively with healthcare business, configuration, and testing teams. Salary and Other Compensation: Applicants will be accepted till 9/20/2026 Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship. *Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or spo

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Workday Finance Testing Engineer Experience: 6 Yrs to 15 Yrs Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Chennai / Remote Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Workday Finance Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality of Workday Financial Management implementations, enhancements, integrations, and upgrades. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Workday Financials modules, test planning, execution, defect management, and end-to-end business process validation. Key Responsibilities Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and Workday Finance configurations. Design, develop, and execute test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts for Workday Financial Management modules. Verify data migration and data reconciliation activities. Execute end-to-end business process testing and financial workflow validations. Log, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, developers, and integration teams. Support Workday releases, upgrades, and production validation activities. Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics. Required Skills Workday Functional Skills Strong understanding of Workday Financial Management modules. Experience in testing Workday Finance implementations or support projects. Knowledge of Workday business processes and security configurations. Understanding of financial accounting principles and ERP processes. Testing Skills Functional Testing System Integration Testing (SIT) Regression Testing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) End-to-End Testing Defect Management Test Planning & Execution #LI-SN3
